Cleanses and brightens skin.

Cleanse and clear away dullness with the power of pure lemon extract.

Gently massage onto wet face while avoiding eye area. Rinse off with water. Use day and night as needed.

Keep away from direct sunlight. Store at room temperature.

STEP 5: MOISTURIZE with the Garnier Vitamin C Day Cream Moisturizer. Massage in upward circular motion all over your face, to lock in moisture and create a protective barrier on your skin.

WHAT IS IT
A gentle, easy to rinse foam with the power of Pure Lemon Extract to intensively cleanse and clear dullness.
WHAT IT DOES
Cleanses and brightens skin.
WHY IT'S PERFECT FOR YOU
Cleanse and clear away dullness with the power of pure lemon extract.
HOW TO USE
Gently massage onto wet face while avoiding eye area. Rinse off with water. Use day and night as needed.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
Keep away from direct sunlight. Store at room temperature.
INGREDIENTS
AQUA/WATER, GLYCERIN, MYRISTIC ACID, PAMITIC ACID, STEARIC ACID, GLYCERYL STEARATE, KAOLIN, BENZYL SALICYLATE, CITRUS MEDICA EXTRACT, LIMONENE, LINALOOL. METHYLISOTHIAZOLINONE, PEG-14M, TETRASODIUM EDTA, PARFUM/ FRAGRANCE (B45631/1)
Daytime Morning Regimen
STEP 1: REMOVE MAKEUP & IMPURITIES with the Garnier Vitamin C Micellar Water. Saturate a cotton pad with micellar water and gently wipe your face to remove dirt and excess oil.
STEP 2: CLEANSE your face with the Garnier Vitamin C Brightening Cleanser Foam OR Gel Cleanser Wash. Wet your face with water, apply a small amount of the cleanser, and massage in circular motions. Rinse thoroughly.
STEP 3: TREAT with the Garnier Vitamin C Booster Serum. Apply 3-4 drops of the serum all over your face in upward motion. Let it absorb fully before moving on to the next steps. This will help to fade dark spots in 3 days!
STEP 4: ENHANCE your skin with the Garnier Vitamin C Ampoule Serum. Apply a small amount of the ampoule serum on problem areas, or all over your face to fade hyperpigmentation, sunspots (pekas), melasma, and dark undereye circles.
STEP 5: MOISTURIZE with the Garnier Vitamin C Day Cream Moisturizer. Massage in upward circular motion all over your face, to lock in moisture and create a protective barrier on your skin.
STEP 6: PROTECT your skin from harmful UV rays with the Garnier Vitamin C UV Sunscreen. Apply a thin layer of sunscreen evenly on your face, at least 15 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply throughout the day for maximum sun protection.
